notes: The section covers both the Certificate of Achievement and the Associate in Science; the Program Outcomes list is shared by both awards and is recorded here for the certificate.
The certificate is earned by completing the 22.5-unit major; the A.S. adds General Education and electives to reach a minimum of 60 units, which is not recorded as this certificate's degree_total.
The PDF text has broken ligatures (e.g. 'CreaƟ ng'); outcomes and careers were transcribed with the intended characters.

Requirement list prints CIS 062 as 'Creating Web Interactivity with Flash', CIS 069 as 'Multimedia for the Web', CIS 087 as 'Adobe Illustrator for the Web', and BUS 097 as 'Work Readiness'; titles differ from the state file but codes match (CIS 001 = CIS 1, etc.).
Careers 'website designer' and 'developer' come from the description sentence 'employment as a website designer or developer'; the other four from 'Career Opportunities'.
